title: Digital Adaptation Kit (DAK)
description: The L2 layer of a WHO SMART Guideline: the ten components that make a guideline's recommendations operational, ahead of the L3 FHIR IG that implements them. Fixed: a DAK has exactly these components, in this order.

sections.title: Health Interventions & Recommendations
sections.description: Relevant health interventions and recommendations from the WHO guideline and guidance. To inform DAK scope.

sections.title: Generic Personas
sections.description: Roles, responsibilities, and essential interventions performed by targeted personas. Example for human centered design.

sections.title: User Scenarios
sections.description: Brief narrative description of how the targeted personas may engage with the digital system. Example for human centered design.

sections.title: Business Processes & Workflows
sections.description: Generic workflows representing clinical and non-clinical processes. To inform when data is collected and used & required features.

sections.title: Core Data Elements
sections.description: Data elements, used for clinical decision-making, indicators, and other data needs. To inform data collection forms and L3 interoperability requirements.

sections.title: Decision Support Logic
sections.description: Decision tables representing counselling and treatment algorithms, and any other logic used to determine workflow paths or clinical actions.

sections.title: Scheduling Logic
sections.description: Decision tables representing scheduling logic according to care plans. Previously combined with decision support logic. Not yet a field of its own in WHO's DAK logical model.

sections.title: Indicators & Monitoring
sections.description: Indicators for reporting & monitoring with numerator, denominator of data elements. Linking person centered data to aggregate.

sections.title: Functional & Non-functional Requirements
sections.description: A non-exhaustive list of key functions and non-functional requirements for a digital tracking and decision support system. To inform system features.

sections.title: Test Scenarios
sections.description: Test data and scenarios to check a system against the other nine components. A test harness to run them.
